title: Graph Engineering verifier verdict
description: One retained ballot. The ballot vocabulary has exactly four members; 'not-cast' belongs to the panel census and can never appear here, because a ballot that exists was cast by definition. A ballot that fails this schema or the semantic rules of verification-semantics.md section 5 is the non-retryable node failure INVALID_VERIFIER_VERDICT after exactly one attempt; it is never coerced to abstain or unknown and never counts as a participant.

verdictHash.description: SHA-256 over frame('graphengineering.verifier-verdict.v1alpha1') || frame(runId) || frame(verifierId) || frame(canonicalSerialize(verdict without verdictHash)). Binding runId and verifierId means a ballot cannot be transplanted between runs or reattributed.

subjectEvidenceHash.description: Digest of the ORIGINAL evidence, never the maker's summary of it.

confidenceBasisPoints.description: Optional integer 1..10000, matching BarrierVote.confidenceBasisPoints exactly so the projection to a barrier vote is the identity on this member. Absence signals 'no confidence supplied'; it is never materialized as null.

abstainReason.description: Present iff verdict is 'abstain'. A verifier abstains from the whole rubric, not from a criterion.

criterionOutcomes.description: Absent iff verdict is 'abstain'. Otherwise exactly one entry per rubric criterion, in rubric declaration order.

findings.description: Ordered and retained. Minor and advisory findings never move the ballot verdict but remain visible in the census.

scores.description: Present iff the rubric mode is 'comparison'. Exactly one entry per frozen candidate, in declared candidate order.

outcome.description: Three members. 'abstain' is a whole-ballot property and is not a criterion outcome.

supportEstablished.description: outcome 'pass' requires true. A verifier may not pass a criterion it did not establish.

basis.description: Must equal the rubric criterion's basis. A deterministic check must not be answered by model judgment.

separationProof.description: Maker/verifier separation proof. Exclusion decisions read only this block, the verifier identity, the lens, the rubric hash and the declared capabilities; never the verdict or its content.

evidenceSourceHash.description: Must equal the subject's original evidence hash. Equality with the maker's summary hash is EVIDENCE_NOT_ORIGINAL.

candidateScore.description: normalizedBasisPoints = floor(((rawScore - scaleMin) * 10000) / (scaleMax - scaleMin)). The numerator is non-negative so floor and truncation agree in both languages. Floating-point normalization is forbidden.
